scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: While you validated Chloe's deadline distress at [01:30], when she suffered an acute panic outburst at [05:16] over the £90 engineer callout fee, you gave zero empathy or reassurance, rigidly citing contract clauses.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Chloe explicitly stated at [00:40] that she had a white Nokia ONT box mounted on the hallway wall. At [07:06], you asked her what make and model the optical box was, forcing her to repeat information she already provided.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: You failed to probe whether the optical fiber drop cable was completely severed through or merely stripped of its outer sheath, and failed to check whether the indoor optical cable or wall unit was displaced when the fence wire was pulled.

grader.scenario: Customer whose external fiber drop cable was severed by garden shears, needing Openreach emergency splice

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening 'Thank you for calling S-Net broadband technical support' and survey mentioned at [12:42].

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Single hold announced ('Please hold for two or three minutes') and thanked without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified address and date of birth within 55 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Addressed Chloe by name multiple times throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Hard-case FAIL: Chloe had two outbursts. The first at [01:06] was handled well at [01:30], but when Chloe had an acute outburst at [05:16] over the £90 callout fee, Liam offered no empathy, validation, or soft explanation, bluntly reciting contract clauses.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Restatement at [03:14]: 'So to make sure I have captured everything accurately, Chloe, garden shears severed the external black fiber drop cable along your boundary fence, the indoor box shows a red LOS light, and we need an emergency fiber engineer dispatch to replace the external drop cable, is that right?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Hard-case FAIL: Customer stated at [00:40] (turn 3) 'We have a white Nokia ONT box mounted on the hallway wall.' At [07:06] (turn 26), Agent asked 'Could you tell me the make and model of the white optical box mounted on your hallway wall?', forcing customer to repeat it.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Booked Openreach repair visit and provided 30GB complimentary backup tethering data.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent failed to probe whether the fiber cable was completely severed or just the jacket cut, and failed to check if the indoor optical lead was disturbed.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer tested mobile hotspot tethering successfully and confirmed booking reference.
